SELECT week_ending_date, COUNT(*) AS n_rows, COUNT(DISTINCT (store_key, product_key)) AS n_distinct, COUNT(DISTINCT etl_loaded_at) AS loads, MIN(etl_loaded_at) AS min_load, MAX(etl_loaded_at) AS max_load, SUM(closing_units) AS units
FROM fact_stock_week
WHERE week_ending_date >= DATE '2026-08-30'
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT fiscal_week, MIN(calendar_date) AS wk_start, MAX(calendar_date) AS wk_end, MIN(fiscal_period_label) AS lbl
FROM dim_date WHERE fiscal_year='FY2026/27' AND fiscal_week BETWEEN 16 AND 22 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

WITH s AS (
  SELECT f.*, st.store_id, p.sku, p.category
  FROM fact_stock_week f
  JOIN dim_store st ON st.store_key=f.store_key
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
  WHERE f.week_ending_date = DATE '2026-09-27'
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS n, COUNT(DISTINCT (store_id, sku)) AS nat_distinct,
  SUM(CASE WHEN store_id>=900 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS non_physical_rows,
  SUM(CASE WHEN category='ZZ Test' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS test_rows,
  SUM(CASE WHEN closing_units<0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS neg_rows,
  SUM(CASE WHEN closing_units IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS null_rows,
  MIN(closing_units) AS min_u, MAX(closing_units) AS max_u,
  SUM(CASE WHEN store_id<900 AND category<>'ZZ Test' THEN closing_units END) AS in_scope_units
FROM s

SELECT f.sale_date, COUNT(*) AS n_rows, COUNT(DISTINCT (f.receipt_id, f.line_no)) AS n_keys, COUNT(DISTINCT f.sales_line_id) AS n_ids,
  COUNT(DISTINCT f.etl_loaded_at) AS loads, SUM(f.quantity) AS qty, SUM(CASE WHEN f.quantity<=0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS nonpos,
  SUM(CASE WHEN s.store_id>=900 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS nonphys
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-24' AND DATE '2026-09-20'
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

WITH stock AS (
  SELECT cp.category, SUM(f.closing_units) AS closing_units
  FROM fact_stock_week f
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
  JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku = p.sku AND cp.is_current
  WHERE f.week_ending_date = DATE '2026-09-27' AND s.store_id < 900 AND cp.category <> 'ZZ Test'
  GROUP BY 1
),
sold AS (
  SELECT cp.category, SUM(f.quantity) AS units_4wk
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
  JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku = p.sku AND cp.is_current
  WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-24' AND DATE '2026-09-20' AND s.store_id < 900 AND cp.category <> 'ZZ Test'
  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT 'FY2026/27' AS fiscal_year, 5 AS fiscal_period, st.category, st.closing_units, so.units_4wk, ROUND(so.units_4wk/4.0,1) AS avg_weekly_units,
       ROUND(st.closing_units / (so.units_4wk/4.0), 2) AS weeks_of_cover
FROM stock st LEFT JOIN sold so USING (category) ORDER BY 3

SELECT 'rpt' AS src, SUM(units_sold) AS units, COUNT(DISTINCT store_id) AS stores FROM rpt_daily_store_sales WHERE business_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-24' AND DATE '2026-09-20' AND store_id < 900
UNION ALL
SELECT 'fact', SUM(f.quantity), COUNT(DISTINCT s.store_id) FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-24' AND DATE '2026-09-20' AND s.store_id < 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'stock_store129_rows', COUNT(*), COUNT(DISTINCT s.store_id) FROM fact_stock_week f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key WHERE f.week_ending_date=DATE '2026-09-27' AND s.store_id IN (129, 125, 119)
UNION ALL
SELECT 'stock_stores', COUNT(*), COUNT(DISTINCT s.store_id) FROM fact_stock_week f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key WHERE f.week_ending_date=DATE '2026-09-27'
